Adverity grows customer base

Using LinkedIn Marketing APIs, Adverity broadened the audience for its analytics platform and enhanced retention of customers.

“The LinkedIn Ads API is a cornerstone of Adverity’s reporting proposition. Further integrations with Lead Generation and Audiences APIs have translated into 25% higher win rates for new business, a 10% revenue uplift from existing customers and similar double-digit growth in customer satisfaction scores. We are now preparing to launch Conversions API to strengthen our partnership with LinkedIn further and better meet our customers' needs.”

Fabio De Bernardi
VP Business Development at Adverity
